dedup_policy: exact-duplicate rows (per '_is_exact_duplicate') are NOT automatically dropped at split time; cross-split contamination is prevented by construction since each source_file is assigned to exactly one split. Within-split duplicate handling is a separate, explicit decision made in pipeline.py.
rationale: No explicit file_assignment supplied; derived deterministically by alphabetically sorting discovered source_file values and slicing 60/20/20. This is a placeholder policy — replace with an explicit, documented assignment once real CICIDS2017 filenames/days are confirmed (see docs/methodology/preprocessing.md).
